port.label: Port
port.description: The page is served on this loopback port. Set another one to run a second page beside this one.

fuse.label: Snapshot before a command
fuse.description: Take a snapshot of the saves before the first command of a window is run. POST /fuse snapshots on demand either way.

fuseMinutes.label: Reuse a snapshot for
fuseMinutes.description: How long one snapshot serves the commands that follow it, so a run of twenty commands writes one folder instead of twenty. 0 snapshots before every command.

keep.label: Snapshots to keep
keep.description: Older snapshots are removed beyond this many. Each one is about 1.8 MB.
